biotools.summary: PySurvival is an open-source Python package for survival analysis modeling, built upon machine learning packages like NumPy, SciPy, and PyTorch. It was used to develop a deep learning-based survival model for triple-negative breast cancer, achieving strong performance compared to traditional methods.
